blocks.text: Rondae Hollis-Jefferson played managed minutes in his much-awaited return on Tuesday—even if he felt like he played for an eternity. “It’s a different feel. It’s a different type of endurance,” Hollis-Jefferson said. “I felt like I played 40 minutes again, and it was [only] 22.” Those 22 were the only minutes TNT needed from him. […]...
